high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Fortune.com, displayed on a mobile device. The top of the screen shows the time as 3:31 PM with a battery icon indicating the phone's battery level. The website URL "fortune.com" is visible at the top of the browser. The article discusses a concept called "vibe coding," which involves using natural language prompts to generate and iterate on code. The text explains that instead of writing complex syntax, users describe their intent, and AI produces functioning prototypes. This shift is described as a significant change in how software is developed.

style_description.aesthetics: Digital screenshot, UI or software interface.
